description: Answers "How is my account doing?" with account value, cash, unrealized P&L and position count for each connected broker account, an account value history chart from saved daily snapshots, and an allocation donut when holdings are complete. Paper and live accounts are shown separately. Accounts that need reconnecting come back with a reconnect link. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
name: show_account_overview
title: Show account overview
